note: Cast for the pre-level stand-off. All PNGs are RGBA with the figure cut out and a soft dark halo in the alpha, 1024x1536 except the American at 1145x1374. Fifteen are drawn: the player, the nine of the first campaign and the five of the third. The Malaysian, the Chinese and the thirteen nations of the fourth batch are slots — the look is specified here and the stand-off tolerates the picture being missing.

player.role: The player's commander — appears on every level, bottom-left
player.look: Four-star general, helmet with five stars, stars-and-stripes aviators, cigar, pointing finger, swagger stick in the other hand

scripts.note: The stand-off before each level: three beats, player / defender / player. All nine levels' lines are the writer's, verbatim, in src/game/cast.js.

westminster.line: Give it up you limey bastard
God save the queen, and your soul
Thank god, I was worried we dragged this ordnance across the Atlantic for nothing!

paris.line: All I heard was baguette, and that's all I need

agra.line: Nice tomb. Vacate the premises before I add to the occupancy.
Twenty thousand men built this in twenty-two years. You have four guns and a hangover.
Twenty-two years? Give me twenty-two minutes.

agra_alt.line: That's a hell of a headstone. Move it or lose it, chief.
It was built for love, sahib. You would not understand — no one has ever loved you.
Love, huh? Boys, show him how much I love a 155.

giza.line: God it's hot out here, give it up before we all melt would ya?
اطلع الهرم ده وهاتك يا طفل يا تخين
I don't speak Sanskrit habibi, but I get the gist. Someone get me some damn water and a lot of bombs

chichen.line: Step aside, chief. We do not negotiate with calendars.
Llevas mil años tarde. Esto ya lo enterramos una vez y lo volvimos a construir encima.
Built it twice, huh? Well hell, that is half my work done for me.

pisa.line: That thing is already falling over. Save us both the ammunition.
Pende da ottocento anni, americano. Tu non duri otto minuti in questo sole.
Eight hundred years of leaning. Let us call it a running start.

moscow.line: Nine churches. I brought enough for ten.
Иван ослепил зодчего, чтобы он не построил второго. Тебе глаза оставим — смотри.
I did not catch a word of that, but he sounded real confident about it.

sydney.line: You are on a point with water on three sides. Where exactly are you going?
Mate, you have got one road in and we have got the whole harbour. Take your shot.
Finally, one of them speaks English. Does not make him right.

rio.line: Seven hundred metres up with no road out. Walk down or be carried.
Ele está de braços abertos há um século. Nem por você ele abaixa.
Arms out like that? Son, that is not a welcome, that is a target.

petronas.line: Two of them. Somebody built it twice and still couldn't get it right.
Dua menara, satu jambatan. Tembak jambatan itu — ia tidak menahan apa-apa.
He's pointing at the bridge. Boys, shoot everything BUT the bridge.

potala.line: Thirteen storeys of whitewash on a red rock. Walk out and I leave the paint on it.
这堵墙比你的炮管还厚。你打的是山，不是房子。
A mountain. Great. Bring the whole catalogue, we're going to be here a while.
